title: Confidence Decay System Contract
description: Specification for temporal awareness and confidence decay calculations. Defines how entity confidence scores decay over time and get reinforced by access patterns.

base_confidence.description: All entities start with confidence 1.0 at creation

decay_rate.description: Graph-specific decay rate (configurable per graph instance)

weeks_elapsed.description: Time since last access in weeks (Unix timestamps in seconds)

implementation.storage: timestamps only (created_at, last_accessed), not decayed confidence values

world-foundations.rationale: Core world rules don't fade (magic systems, pantheon, cosmology are permanent)

political-web.rationale: NPC relationships fade over 2-3 months if not referenced

geographical.rationale: Locations don't change quickly, persist longer than NPCs

campaign-story.rationale: Story details fade fast, recent sessions matter most

reinforcement.description: Confidence increases when entities are accessed (queries, AI mentions, manual views)
reinforcement.mechanism: Update last_accessed timestamp to current time, recalculate confidence
reinforcement.formula_effect: Setting last_accessed = now() causes weeks_elapsed = 0, so confidence = 1.0 * (1 - decay_rate * 0) = 1.0

triggers.behavior: Manual reinforcement by user or AI

triggers.implementation: Update last_accessed when entity referenced in AI response

pinning.description: Pin critical entities to prevent decay (BBEGs, major factions, key locations)
pinning.mechanism: Set pinned flag to true, bypass decay formula
pinning.formula_override: if (entity.pinned) return 1.0; else apply decay formula
use_cases: BBEG scheming in background (not encountered for 5+ sessions)
Major factions always relevant to campaign
Key locations party will return to

observations.description: Free-form text observations on entities have individual confidence decay
observations.decay_behavior: Same formula as entities, using observation's created_at and last_accessed
observations.independence: Each observation decays independently from entity
observations.use_case: Entity may have high confidence but specific observations decay (e.g., 'current location: Waterdeep' fades after 10 weeks)
observations.storage: JSON array in graph_entities.observations: [{text, created_at, last_accessed}]

relations.description: Relations between entities have confidence calculated from connected entities
relations.inheritance: Relations do not have independent confidence, inherited from entities
relations.pinning_behavior: Pinned entity with confidence 1.0 connected to decayed entity (0.3) = relation confidence 0.65
relations.access_behavior: Accessing relation updates last_accessed for BOTH entities (reinforces both sides)

performance.approach: In-memory calculation, no database writes during query
performance.optimization: Calculate only for queried entities, not entire graph

graph_versioning.description: Confidence metadata (last_accessed, pinned) restored during revert
graph_versioning.revert_behavior: Restore all timestamps from backup snapshot, recalculate confidence on-demand
graph_versioning.note: Confidence NOT stored in snapshot, only timestamps. Confidence recalculated using snapshot timestamps and revert_timestamp.

confidence_high.ai_response: Use entity confidently, no uncertainty expressed
confidence_high.example: Lord Eddard Stark is the Hand of the King and is investigating Jon Arryn's death.

confidence_medium.ai_response: Use entity but note it's been a while
confidence_medium.example: Guard Captain Bob (I believe he's still stationed at the gate, though it's been some time).

confidence_low.example: I'm not completely sure about Guard Captain Bob - can you give me a refresher on his role?

user_refresher_workflow.step_1: AI expresses uncertainty for low-confidence entity
user_refresher_workflow.step_5: AI uses refreshed entity confidently in next response

entity_list.confidence_display: Show confidence score next to entity name (e.g., 'Guard Captain Bob (0.2)')
entity_list.filtering: Allow filter by confidence range (e.g., show only entities with confidence > 0.5)

confidence_indicator_component.tooltip: Show last_accessed timestamp and weeks_elapsed on hover

scenario_1_decay_over_time.description: Entity decays from 1.0 to 0.6 after 4 weeks (Political-Web graph)

scenario_2_reinforcement.description: Low-confidence entity (0.3) accessed, confidence increases to 1.0

scenario_3_pinned_entity.description: Pinned entity maintains confidence 1.0 after 10 weeks

scenario_4_relation_confidence.description: Relation confidence is average of two entities
